gian: grows cross: she leans a little forward over the gold rim holding a small cracked porcelain teacup in both hands, her brows knit, her lips press tight, she huffs once through her nose; the cup stays in her hands, no smashing, no shards

stays cross in a slow loop: she taps a fingertip on the small cracked teacup, frowns with knitted brows, lips pressed tight, gives one small stern huff; the cup stays in her hands, no smashing, no shards
buon: grows sad: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, her eyes lower and glisten, one single tear rolls down her cheek, one hand holds a folded white handkerchief near her chest, the other rests on the rim; mouth closed, no sobbing
stays sad in a slow loop: she sighs softly, her lowered eyes blink slowly, she presses the folded handkerchief to her chest, the one tear glistens on her cheek; mouth closed, no sobbing, no wiping
vui: is happy to give a reward: she leans a little forward over the gold rim with a warm happy smile, both hands holding a small gold ingot and a little red coin pouch together, a few tiny gold sparkles twinkle
stays happy in a slow loop: she gives the little red coin pouch a small jingle, smiles warmly with crinkled eyes, nods once, the tiny gold sparkles twinkle; the ingot and pouch stay in her hands
so: takes a fright: she leans a little forward over the gold rim and pulls a purple flowered quilt up to her chin with both hands, her eyes go wide and peek over it
stays frightened in a slow loop: she peeks over the purple flowered quilt with wide eyes, glances left and right together, tugs the quilt a little higher, small shiver of her shoulders
lo: is worn out: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, both hands resting on the rim, her tired eyelids droop, dark rings under her eyes, loose strands of hair sway
stays tired in a slow loop: her droopy eyelids slowly close and open again, her head nods a little, she breathes out a slow tired sigh, both hands stay resting on the rim; no yawning, no eye rubbing
